what_is_wrong: Main JS bundle is 3.69 MB raw / ~970 KB gzipped. Every visitor, including parents on phones hitting /parent-login, downloads the whole admin + curriculum + music app before anything renders. App.jsx statically imports ~150 page components and uses zero React.lazy.
how_you_saw_it: run_command: npx vite build --outDir /tmp/fpbuild -> assets/index-45DC4TbD.js 3,690,144 bytes; gzip -c | wc -c = 993,503; grep -c 'lazy(' src/App.jsx = 0
proposed_fix: Route-level code splitting: convert page imports in src/App.jsx to React.lazy() + <Suspense>, at minimum split /parent/*, /admin/*, /fws/*, /curriculum/*, music/story studios into separate chunks. Target <300 KB gzip for the parent/public entry.

what_is_wrong: Vite logLevel is set to 'error', which hides the >500 KB chunk-size warning and every other build warning, so bundle bloat goes unnoticed.
how_you_saw_it: vite.config.js line: logLevel: 'error', // Suppress warnings, only show errors; build output shows no chunk warning despite a 3.69 MB chunk
proposed_fix: Set logLevel back to 'warn' (or 'info') and optionally build.chunkSizeWarningLimit so regressions show up.

what_is_wrong: The routes marked as public ('no auth required') sit inside AuthenticatedApp, which returns navigateToLogin() before <Routes> renders whenever the public-settings call answers auth_required. If the app is set to private, anonymous parents/trainees are sent to the Base44 login page and never see these public pages. Could not confirm on the live site (see X-15).
how_you_saw_it: Code read: src/App.jsx AuthenticatedApp -> if (authError.type === 'auth_required') { navigateToLogin(); return null; } comes before <Route path="/parent-login"> and <Route path="/register-training">; src/lib/AuthContext.jsx sets auth_required from the /public-settings 403
proposed_fix: Render the public routes outside the auth gate (e.g. check location.pathname against a PUBLIC_PATHS list before calling navigateToLogin, or wrap only private routes in a guard). Then check logged-out in an incognito window.

what_is_wrong: ESLint fails: 90 errors (89 unused imports plus 1 config error). This isn't blocking now, but 'npm run lint' can't be used as a CI gate.
how_you_saw_it: run_command: npx eslint . --quiet -> '90 problems (90 errors, 0 warnings) 89 errors ... potentially fixable with the --fix option'
proposed_fix: Run 'npm run lint:fix' once (auto-removes the unused imports), then keep lint clean.

what_is_wrong: An eslint-disable comment names rule 'react-hooks/exhaustive-deps', but that rule is not active in eslint.config.js, so ESLint reports a config error and hooks dependency bugs are not checked anywhere.
how_you_saw_it: eslint output: '110:5 error Definition for rule 'react-hooks/exhaustive-deps' was not found'
proposed_fix: Enable pluginReactHooks.configs.recommended rules (rules-of-hooks + exhaustive-deps) in eslint.config.js, or remove the stale disable comment.

what_is_wrong: Lint only covers src/components, src/pages and src/Layout.jsx. src/App.jsx, src/lib, src/fws, src/hooks and src/utils are never linted, which is why 25 unused page imports in App.jsx went unflagged.
proposed_fix: Widen the files glob to src/**/*.{js,jsx} (keep ignoring components/ui).

what_is_wrong: 25 page components are imported but never routed, so they are dead code and still sit in the bundle: MyChild, WeeklySummary, TipsAndGuidance, Messages, MyAccount, HWGrowth, ParentDashboard, ParentInbox, ParentWeeklySummary, ParentSongs, ParentGrowthMindset, ParentReflect, ParentJourney, ParentMilestoneLibrary, ParentMessages, ParentHeartWise, ParentHeartWiseDetail, ParentWords, ParentQuestions, ParentSettings, ParentHeartWiseBook, ParentPath, ParentReadingNumbers, ParentFirstWords, ParentFirstMoments.
how_you_saw_it: run_command: for each default import in src/App.jsx, grep for '<Name' JSX usage -> 0 hits for the 25 names listed
proposed_fix: Delete the unused imports (and the page files, once confirmed retired, since their routes now LegacyRedirect elsewhere). This also shrinks X-01.

what_is_wrong: Two page files are not imported or routed anywhere, so they can't be reached.
how_you_saw_it: run_command: grep across src for an import of each page basename -> no importer for these two
proposed_fix: Route them if needed (e.g. an OAuth consent flow), otherwise delete them.

what_is_wrong: Some legacy redirects take two hops: /my-child/first-words -> /parent/first-words -> /parent/playground/words; /my-child/path -> /parent/path -> /parent/playground/path; /my-child/reading-numbers -> /parent/reading-numbers -> /parent; first-moments the same. All of them end on a real route (none are broken), but the /my-child/* and /kasvunpolku/* ones sit inside AppShell, so the staff shell mounts before the parent redirect.
how_you_saw_it: Code read of src/App.jsx Navigate/LegacyRedirect targets, cross-checked against the defined paths; no duplicate path= values (sort | uniq -d empty)
proposed_fix: Point the legacy Navigate targets straight at the final path, and move the /my-child/* and /kasvunpolku/* redirects out of the AppShell element.

what_is_wrong: The same admin screen (KasvunpolkuControl) is mounted on 3 paths. /parent/admin renders it inside the parent-only ParentGuard + ParentShell, which exposes a staff admin screen in the parent area.
proposed_fix: Remove /parent/admin (or change it to a redirect to /admin/kasvunpolku), and make sure KasvunpolkuControl checks for an admin role itself.

what_is_wrong: The HTML shell has no meta description and no og:title / og:image. The title is 'Polaricx', not the Finniped brand, and the favicon is Base44's logo (https://base44.com/logo_v2.svg), so link previews and browser tabs show Base44/Polaricx branding on finniped.com.
how_you_saw_it: Read index.html: <title>Polaricx</title>; <link rel=""icon"" href=""https://base44.com/logo_v2.svg"">; no <meta name=""description"">
proposed_fix: Add a meta description, Open Graph/Twitter tags, a proper favicon and apple-touch-icon in public/, and a title that matches the brand used on finniped.com.

what_is_wrong: The manifest start_url is /parent/dashboard, which is only a redirect to /parent. The same single generated PNG is declared as both the 192x192 and 512x512 icon with purpose 'any maskable'. The icon is hosted off-site on media.base44.com, so an installed PWA icon depends on third-party hosting.
proposed_fix: Set start_url to /parent. Ship real 192 and 512 PNG icons in public/ with separate 'any' and 'maskable' entries.

what_is_wrong: jszip is loaded at runtime with import('https://esm.sh/jszip@3.10.1'), meaning code is executed from a third-party CDN without integrity pinning. The Finniped import breaks if esm.sh is blocked or down.
how_you_saw_it: src/lib/finnipedImport.js: const mod = await import(/* @vite-ignore */ "https://esm.sh/jszip@3.10.1"); comment says 'jszip is not a dependency of this app'
proposed_fix: Add jszip to package.json and import it normally (it gets bundled and lazy-loaded with the admin import page).

what_is_wrong: The build warns that the classes duration-[250ms] and duration-[400ms] are ambiguous (they match multiple utilities), so the intended transition duration may not apply. The browserslist/caniuse-lite data is also 7 months old.
how_you_saw_it: Build log /tmp/build.txt in the sandbox: 'warn - The class `duration-[250ms]` is ambiguous and matches multiple utilities.'
proposed_fix: Use duration-250 / duration-400 (or [transition-duration:250ms]). Run npx update-browserslist-db@latest.

what_is_wrong: LIVE-SITE CHECKS NOT DONE: the audit environment could not reach finniped.com. Playwright gets net::ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED from the egress proxy, and the local curl HEAD checks (Unsplash, media.base44.com, esm.sh, finniped.com) were blocked or returned 000. Console errors, failed requests, load time, mobile overflow, alt text and broken images on the live pages are still unverified, and so are the 10 external image URLs.
how_you_saw_it: Playwright run (scratchpad audit_r1.js): all 10 page/width combinations -> 'page.goto: net::ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED'; curl -> http_code 000. Screenshots were Chrome error pages and were deleted, not kept as evidence.
proposed_fix: Re-run audit_r1.js (in the scratchpad) from a machine with open internet access, or allow finniped.com, images.unsplash.com, media.base44.com and esm.sh in the agent proxy.

what_is_wrong: The latest Base44 security scan is out of date and holds no usable findings (result = null, because the app or scanner changed since the last run). Static code analysis is enabled. No current read-only security evidence exists for the app.
proposed_fix: Run a new scan (POST /security/scan, or Security in the builder), which was not done here because the audit is read-only, then review the RLS, secrets and static findings.

what_is_wrong: No SEO scan has ever been run for the app (the SEO summary is null). The published slug URL is https://nordic-pedagogy-flow.base44.app and stays live alongside finniped.com, which risks duplicate-content indexing unless it redirects or sets a canonical.
proposed_fix: Run an SEO scan. Add <link rel="canonical"> pointing to finniped.com, or redirect the base44.app slug to it.

what_is_wrong: No oversized assets: public/ is 24 KB in total (manifest.json, parent-sw.js and 3 sample JSON files) and nothing is over 500 KB. There are no local images at all. All imagery is remote: 10 Unsplash photos at w=1800 in src/components/training/ttHelpers.jsx, which are heavy for mobile hero images.
how_you_saw_it: run_command: du -sh public -> 24K; find public -size +500k -> none; grep of src for image URLs
